claims.claim: Every A9 packing can be normalized into an 1188×839 subrectangle of A0.
claims.evidence: Fixing labels and orientations gives a compact feasible coordinate space. At a minimizer of the sum of all left and top coordinates, every rectangle away from x=0 has a touching left blocker with positive vertical overlap, since otherwise a sufficiently small left translation would remain feasible and lower the objective; the analogous statement holds vertically. Following blockers strictly decreases the relevant coordinate and terminates at zero. Thus every right and bottom edge is a nonnegative integer combination of 37 and 52. Exact enumeration confirms that the largest such value at most 1189 is 1188 and the largest at most 841 is 839; 1189, 840, and 841 are not representable. Hence a same-cardinality packing exists inside [0,1188]×[0,839].
claims.witness: Extremal edge certificates: 1188=20·52+4·37 and 839=14·52+3·37, with no representations of 1189, 840, or 841.
claims.search_method: Compactness and blocker-chain proof followed by exhaustive integer enumeration of the semigroup generated by 37 and 52.

claims.claim: There is an explicit packing of 516 sheets.
claims.evidence: The three stated grids generate exactly 60, 8, and 448 rectangles. Every rectangle has dimensions 52×37 or 37×52 and lies within 1188×839. Exact checking of all 132,870 unordered pairs found every pair interior-disjoint. Therefore the coordinates give a valid 516-sheet packing in the reduced container and hence in A0.
claims.search_method: Exact generation, dimension and containment checks, followed by exhaustive pairwise rectangle-intersection testing.

claims.claim: No packing has 518 sheets; hence OPT≤517.
claims.evidence: Claim 0 reduces arbitrary real-coordinate packings to integer-coordinate packings. For markers satisfying x+y≡50 mod 52, a 52×37 rectangle contains exactly one marker in each of its 37 rows, while a 37×52 rectangle contains exactly one in each of its 37 columns. Thus either orientation has weight one when each marker has weight 1/37. The checker tested all 52² starting-residue pairs for both orientations and counted exactly 19,162 markers in 1188×839. The total weight is 19,162/37=517+33/37<518, so an integral packing cardinality is at most 517.
claims.witness: The nonnegative periodic marker weight map assigning weight 1/37 exactly to cells with x+y≡50 (mod 52).
claims.search_method: Exhaustive exact residue-class verification for both orientations and direct integer counting over all reduced-container cells.

claims.claim: Any hypothetical 517-packing must span a maximum reduced dimension and contain a prescribed blocking chain.
claims.evidence: For the normalized representative, 517·52·37=994,708, whereas 1187·838=994,706. Therefore its maximum right edge is 1188 or its maximum bottom edge is 839. Following the corresponding blocker chain from a boundary-reaching rectangle back to zero makes the chain widths or heights sum to that extremal dimension. Exact enumeration gives the unique representations 1188=20·52+4·37 and 839=14·52+3·37. The result is correctly stated only as a necessary condition on a normalized hypothetical packing, not as an exclusion of 517.
claims.witness: Either a width chain with twenty width-52 and four width-37 sheets, or a height chain with fourteen height-52 and three height-37 sheets.
claims.search_method: Exact area comparison, blocker-chain argument, and exhaustive enumeration of extremal semigroup representations.

claims.claim: The natural horizontal 111+728 decomposition is exactly capped at 516.
claims.evidence: For the fixed decomposition at y=111, area caps the 1188×111 part at 68, attained by the two top grids. In the 1188×728 part, exact enumeration of all 156 feasible vertical intersection-count patterns verifies 5h+7v≤98, and all 396 feasible horizontal patterns verify 7h+5v≤160. Integrating these inequalities across the container gives 259N+n≤116,424 and 260N−n≤116,480. Hence 519N≤232,904<519·449, so N≤448. The 32×14 grid attains 448, yielding exactly 68+448=516 for this fixed split.
claims.witness: A 68-sheet packing above y=111 and a 448-sheet 32×14 grid below it, together with the two exact line-weight inequalities.
claims.search_method: Area arithmetic, exhaustive enumeration of every integer line-intersection pattern, and exact summation of the resulting inequalities.

claims.claim: The maximum size of a guillotine (slicing) A9-in-A0 packing is 516.
claims.evidence: Compacting a slicing tree is sound: a vertical node takes the sum of child widths and maximum child height, while a horizontal node takes the maximum width and sum of heights. Inductively every compacted dimension belongs to the semigroup generated by 37 and 52, and the root fits within 1188×839 by Claim 0's extremal enumeration. The independent exact DP used every positive representable width and height—395×203 states, corresponding to the draft's 396×204 counts when zero is included—and included monotone slack plus every exact vertical and horizontal semigroup split. Structural induction on the compacted slicing tree proves completeness, while each transition constructs a valid slicing packing and proves soundness. Integer evaluation returned G(1188,839)=516. The displayed construction is slicing: combine the 60- and 8-sheet top grids vertically, then combine that 68-sheet region horizontally with the 448-sheet bottom grid.
claims.witness: A slicing tree with compacted components (1040,111,60), (148,104,8), and (1184,728,448), producing root (1188,839,516).
claims.search_method: Independent bottom-up exact-integer dynamic programming over all representable dimensions, with structural-induction review of recurrence coverage.

target_evidence: The exact target requires deciding whether OPT is 516, 517, or 518. The verified placement and weight certificate establish only 516≤OPT≤517. The blocker-chain, fixed-split, and slicing results constrain possible 517-packings but do not exclude every nonslicing packing. The final writeup explicitly leaves 516 versus 517 unresolved and labels the resolution PARTIAL, so it makes valid material progress without overstating target coverage.
